decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from honojs/hono PR #5084 (fixes issue #5083), merged 2026-07-10. Labeled decontaminated: true because the fix post-dates the May 2026 training cutoff of the models this suite targets (Claude Opus 5); re-check `upstream_merged` against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. The etag middleware passed the If-None-Match header straight to etagMatches(), which compares entity tags literally, so the RFC 9110 wildcard `*` never matched and a conditional GET returned 200 with a full body instead of 304. The fix in src/middleware/etag/index.ts special-cases a bare `*`, treating it as a match when the method is GET or HEAD and the response is ok. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (872997d2); the slice keeps src/, package.json and tsconfig.json and drops .github, benchmarks, perf-measures, docs, runtime-tests and every in-tree *.test.ts. Hono is dependency-free at runtime, so the node-ts image runs the hidden tests with tsx and no install step. Coverage: 3 fail_to_pass tests, each verified to return 200 at the base commit and 304 after the gold patch, covering GET, HEAD, and the empty body a 304 must carry. The 4 pass_to_pass guards cover etag issuance, a matching etag, a non-matching etag, and a 404 not being converted to 304 -- none mention the wildcard, so they pass at the base commit. NOTE: a fourth candidate f2p asserting that `*` inside a list (`W/"other", *`) also matches was written and FAILED at gold as well as base -- the fix deliberately handles only a bare `*` -- so it was removed rather than counted. Do not re-add it without changing the fix's scope.
